title: The Art of Science: A Colorful Exploration of Microscopy and Semiconductors for K-12 Engagement
content: Integrating art into STEM education has been recognized as an effective strategy for enhancing engagement, creativity, and conceptual understanding in young learners [1]. At Purdue University, we have developed a hands-on outreach initiative that introduces K-12 students to microscopy and semiconductor concepts through a multidisciplinary approach that blends scientific exploration with artistic expression. By leveraging students' natural curiosity, we create meaningful and interactive learning experiences that facilitate long-term retention of STEM concepts. This initiative employs tailored methodologies for early learners and older students, emphasizing active participation and visual representation as key learning strategies.
